blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all five current angle views and six pose renders: the rear overskirt still forms a raised central fold mass, and crouch/sit show two long, pointed tails extending below the seated silhouette. Pleat shape and coverage remain unacceptable; no appearance acceptance.
The V21 smooth-polygon shading change does not remove the visible small-scale triangular crumpling across sleeves, shoulders, torso and waist in current renders. Surface finish remains rejected.
Static posed images do not establish continuous body clearance, strain or shorts coverage at inner hip and seat during movement. Fit, deformation and runtime remain unverified and rejected.
Current side and arms-up renders retain a tall neck opening and pronounced sleeve/underarm folds. Clearance and deformation quality remain unapproved.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
